text: At N=64 with 3000 steps, force (layer 1, the distance layer) forms at step 500 in seed 21 but step 1000 in seed 20, and the final margins differ by 0.047. Does the per-seed force margin at step 3000 track the per-seed distance margin (0.55 vs 0.69) or the force control R2 (0.476 vs 0.511)? That would show whether seed variance in force reflects learned structure or control noise.
